activity.notes: Representative transportation-business career begins with Vanderbilt's 1810 Staten Island–Manhattan ferry enterprise and runs through his documented shipping-and-railroad magnate career to 1877; the start is a business event, not his birth year.

sources.title: Vanderbilt Mansion National Historic Site: Monument to the Gilded Age — National Park Service Teaching with Historic Places
sources.citation_text: The National Park Service lesson states that in 1810 sixteen-year-old Cornelius Vanderbilt began accumulating the family fortune by starting a ferry service between Staten Island and Manhattan.

sources.title: Cornelius Vanderbilt (1794-1877) biographical file — Vanderbilt University
sources.citation_text: Vanderbilt University identifies Cornelius Vanderbilt as a successful nineteenth-century shipping and railroad magnate and records his 1794–1877 life dates.
